phase_prompt.label: Phase 2
phase_prompt.summary: Codex corrupted, glyphs glitching, dissolving into ash and digital noise.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic medium shot of a corrupted obsidian slab, its glyphs flickering, red glow fading into grey ash and digital noise. The surface cracks, fragments of black glass dissolve, with a gritty, high‑contrast aesthetic, set in a dark void with floating debris.
